tasks.short: Calculate plaster quantities and order the selected materials

steps.what: Inspect substrates and measure wall areas, openings, coat thicknesses and access constraints for the plastering job
Determine materials needed for the plastering job: select compatible plaster, primer, reinforcement and finish specifications and enter measured quantities in the job calculation in {ERP}
Calculate coverage, agreed waste allowance and pack rounding in {ERP} and compare against physically verified usable stock
Prepare the {PROCUREMENT} order with article codes, pack quantities, supplier, price, delivery address and required date; check the completed order against the job and the purchasing authority
Commit the exact checked purchase order in {PROCUREMENT}
Send the exact purchase order to the checked supplier destination through {PROCUREMENT}

tasks.design: Test native {ERP} coverage and pack-rounding calculations and {PROCUREMENT} catalogue mapping first. Carry the checked quantities into a draft order while the plasterer verifies substrate compatibility, actual stock and the final supplier destination; each commit and send uses that exact checked snapshot.
tasks.previous_blocker: Measurements, coverage units and supplier pack sizes are often reconciled by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured unit conversions and native draft order fields can reduce repeated calculation and entry.
tasks.still_hard: Substrate condition, variable coat thickness, spoilage and acceptable substitutions need trade judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The plasterer judges what will bond and finish correctly on the actual surface.

ambition.what: Nothing beyond better supported material ordering is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less pack arithmetic; material choice and purchasing rights stay with the same authorised person.

reach.task: Coordinate delivery dates with the work sequence
reach.learn: Read access and storage constraints without ordering against an unconfirmed programme.

evidence.claim: Native purchasing forms and coverage calculations can reuse entered measurements and catalogue pack units; compatibility still needs a tradesperson.

assumptions: Boundary is the plasterer's material determination and order placement, excluding supplier fulfilment and other staff's approvals. This scenario assumes the plasterer already has purchasing authority within an existing limit; no new approval role is invented.

The plasterer produces area in square metres, coat thickness, substrate, finish, waste allowance and actual usable stock with material code, quantity and unit; measuring, selection and capture are counted in s1-s3. The supplier catalogue supplies article code, coverage unit, pack size, price and availability date; missing values are checked manually and substitutions are never automatic.
Job delivery address and required date come from the existing job record and are checked in s4. Native configuration is tested before custom work; runtime earns no saving.

Shares are a provisional ordering-work scenario, not measured company baselines. The one-percent commit and send are retained normal actions. Final s4 checking covers exact articles, quantities, price, authority, address, date and supplier recipient after the order exists; edits void the check.
unknowns: Whether measured areas already feed native quantities
Whether usable stock is accurate and which purchases need another role's approval
research_questions: Does a normal plaster order require repeated coverage and pack arithmetic that the current system can already perform?

already_counted.description: Stock and coverage reconciliation plus final order checking remain in s3 and s4.

incremental.description: Maintain material unit mappings and investigate catalogue mismatches.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed order snapshot checked in s4; any edit voids approval.
Same order contents committed in s5, with supplier destination checked in s4; any change requires rechecking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Repeated manual coverage arithmetic and order entry give 12.75 gross less 1.5 upkeep, or 11.25 net. Native calculation already configured gives little benefit, so zero is plausible; measurements, material choice, commit and send retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: More attention to substrates and deliveries, with unchanged purchasing authority.
reach: Coordinate material delivery with the construction supervisor.
role.ambitious_version: A plasterer who can explain and trace each order back to actual surfaces and the chosen finish.
